supersedes: the deferred universal skill list (data/rules/core.json: skills.final_list == "deferred")
note: Inspired especially by Eclipse Phase and Cities Without Number, but its own system. Carries no EP2 numerical mechanics (no linked aptitudes, percentiles, or defaulting formula).

skills.name: Administrate
skills.summary: Managing an organization: bureaucracy, logistics, budgets, project management, institutional procedure, personnel.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.summary: Physical activity in gravity: climbing, running, swimming, jumping, gymnastics, throwing, winged flight.

skills.name: Clairvoyance
skills.summary: Anomalous and remote perception; Remote Viewing and Psychometry are techniques within it.

skills.name: Connect
skills.summary: Finding and using social connections: contacts, networking, informal channels.

skills.name: Deceive
skills.summary: Lying, bluffing, conning, fast talk, impersonation, acting, misrepresentation.

skills.name: Exotic Skill
skills.summary: Unusual capabilities that fit nowhere else, used sparingly.

skills.name: Fray
skills.summary: Getting out of the way of danger: dodging, evasive movement, avoiding sudden hazards. Evasion only; combat defence procedure is deferred.

skills.name: Free Fall
skills.summary: Physical activity in microgravity or free fall: maneuvering, orientation, EVA, spin recovery.

skills.name: Guns
skills.summary: Aiming and shooting ranged weapons: beam, kinetic, seeker, spray, handguns, rifles.

skills.name: Hardware
skills.summary: Building, repairing, disabling, upgrading and physically hacking technological systems.

skills.name: Infosec
skills.summary: Hacking or protecting devices and networks: intrusion, exploitation, malware, defence, hardening, counter-hacking.

skills.name: Interface
skills.summary: Operating and interacting with computers, devices, AR/VR, networks, cyberware and machine systems. Interface quality modifies the roll.

skills.name: Kinesics
skills.summary: Reading people: body language, tells, social cues, emotional signals. Opposes Deceive.

skills.name: Know
skills.summary: Academic, scientific, technical, cultural or theoretical knowledge of a field.

skills.name: Lead
skills.summary: Leadership: command, motivating people, coordinating teams, combat, political and crisis leadership.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.summary: Diagnosing and healing. First Aid folds into Medicine (Emergency Care).

skills.name: Melee
skills.summary: Fighting with held or improvised melee weapons; finesse weapons may use REF.

skills.name: Noöspace
skills.summary: Entering, navigating, perceiving and acting in Noöspace; Noetic Projection and Channeling are techniques within it.

skills.name: Perceive
skills.summary: Awareness through the senses: sight, hearing, smell, touch, situational awareness, noticing hidden detail.

skills.name: Perform
skills.summary: Performing art or expressive activity; SOC when primarily social.

skills.name: Pilot
skills.summary: Piloting or driving vehicles; related categories may be used at -1.

skills.name: Precognition
skills.summary: Anomalous perception of future probabilities.

skills.name: Program
skills.summary: Writing and modifying software: scripting, apps, AI tools, nanofabrication programming, virtual environments.

skills.name: Provoke
skills.summary: Moving someone emotionally: intimidation, taunting, seduction, agitation, emotional manipulation.

skills.name: Psychic Defence
skills.summary: Resisting telepathy, intrusion, possession, influence and noetic attack; absorbs the former Counter-Psi domain.

skills.name: Psychokinesis
skills.summary: Influencing physical systems and matter through PSI; the physical, potentially offensive discipline.

skills.name: Research
skills.summary: Finding and synthesizing external information: online, archives, databases, public records, OSINT.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.summary: Sneaking, hiding, stalking, concealing movement, escaping detection.

skills.name: Survival
skills.summary: Operating in hostile environments: wilderness and urban survival, navigation, shelter, food and water, hazards.

skills.name: Talk
skills.summary: Persuading through ordinary communication: persuasion, negotiation, diplomacy, rapport, convincing.

skills.name: Telepathy
skills.summary: Reading and transmitting thoughts, emotion and mental content; mind-to-mind contact.

skills.name: Trade
skills.summary: Buying and selling on markets: bargaining, valuation, negotiating prices, commercial dealing.

skills.name: Unarmed
skills.summary: Unarmed combat: striking, grappling, restraint, takedowns, holds, non-lethal subdual.

skills.name: Work
skills.summary: Broad practical occupational competence; attribute set by the field.

overlap_resolutions.social_cluster: Talk persuades by argument; Provoke moves emotion; Deceive misrepresents; Kinesics reads others; Connect finds people; Lead directs groups.
overlap_resolutions.technical_cluster: Program creates/modifies software; Infosec attacks/defends systems; Interface operates/interacts with systems; Hardware physically builds/repairs devices.
overlap_resolutions.knowledge_cluster: Research finds and verifies external info; Know holds domain understanding; investigation/law-enforcement/intelligence/counterintelligence are Know fields.
overlap_resolutions.work_vs_dedicated: Dedicated skills outperform a broad Work for specialised tasks.
overlap_resolutions.tactics: No separate skill; covered by Lead plus a relevant Know field.

psi_note: The generic Psi placeholder is replaced by six disciplines. Psychic attack is performed through the disciplines, not as a separate skill. Psychotronics remains Hardware (Psychotronics) (CYB).
deferred: psionic powers, sleights, their effects and resolution

unsa_academy_alignment.note: The academy's needs map onto the universal list; specialist knowledge lives in Know fields. No separate Tactics/Police-Procedure/Forensics skills.
